# CIRCLE

CIRCLE is an invite-free Indian community connecting creators, freelancers, video clippers, and brands, operated by Portfolix Enterprise Pvt Ltd in Kochi, India, with Portfolix.Media and Portfolix.Tech.

## Video Clipping (Pay-per-view)
CIRCLE's performance video clipping marketplace connects long-form content creators and brands with skilled vertical video editors. Clippers edit YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels from approved source footage and earn ₹10 to ₹200 per 1,000 verified views based on a single view count snapshot taken on Day 7. CIRCLE invoices a 10% owner fee on budgets and deducts a 10% platform fee from creator earnings upon payout.

## Social Media PR (Pay-per-post, 10K+ Followers)
CIRCLE's pay-per-post PR campaign engine allows brands and verified individuals to book established creators and niche pages with 10,000+ admin-verified followers. Brands pay 100% upfront into escrow. Creator deliverables undergo optional draft approval and must remain live, public, and unedited for 7 days with ASCI ad disclosures (#ad or #collab) before escrow payout release.
